findings.finding: The final patch implements both calendar-neutral comparisons and marks both new public struct methods [Pure]. LocalDate compares DaysSinceEpoch. LocalDateTime compares dates with LocalDate.CompareToIgnoringCalendar first, then compares LocalTime only for the same physical day.
evidence: Fresh public replay code-kb lookup/context shows [Pure] on LocalDate.CompareToIgnoringCalendar at src/NodaTime/LocalDate.cs:539-540; its body returns DaysSinceEpoch.CompareTo(other.DaysSinceEpoch).

Fresh public replay code-kb lookup/context shows [Pure] on LocalDateTime.CompareToIgnoringCalendar at src/NodaTime/LocalDateTime.cs:492-497; its body compares date.CompareToIgnoringCalendar(other.date), returns a nonzero day result, then compares time.
The new XML documentation describes physical-day ordering for LocalDate and physical day followed by time for LocalDateTime. Neither method converts through DateTime or mutates a calendar.

evidence: Fresh public replay code-kb context shows LocalDate.CompareTo at src/NodaTime/LocalDate.cs:525-529 checking CalendarOrdinal before TrustedCompareTo.
